task: Independent semantic provider request and admission seam

gate.criterion: An explicitly attached semantic provider may return only validated, content-addressed evidence; no provider output may become a capability, ActionIntent, tool call, or Workbench side effect at interpretation time.

boundary: This Gate establishes the provider seam and honest unavailable state. It does not claim real model quality, broad language understanding, automatic provider selection, Workbench execution, CUDA, CI, or open-domain autonomy.
